## THE ROTΑ AT THE END OF THE VOLUME, AND THE OTHER TWO CLOCKS

**THE ROTA IS IN FORCE AND IS NOT A TEST AND THE TWO ARE NOT THE SAME THING, and that sentence is on the page in Ch 245 and was written into the covenant on the twenty-seventh in the form THE NODE IS WORKED, NOT PATTERNED.** In force from the second hour of the morning of the twenty-second of the second month. Four-day cycle, anchored on Ch 228. **AT THE THIRTIETH OF THE THIRD MONTH: THIRTY-NINE MORNINGS IN FORCE, TWENTY-NINE TAKEN, TEN NOT, AND ALL TEN OF THE TEN ARE THE FOURTH LINE.** The fields waited ten times and the seventh line says nobody is blamed and nobody is. **THE FOURTH LINE CAME ROUND ON THE TWENTY-SECOND OF THIS MONTH AND THE FIELDS ABOVE MARDEN WAITED FOR A DAY AND A NIGHT WHILE FIVE PEOPLE WERE STANDING ON A STONE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS BELOW THEM, AND THOSE TWO FACTS ARE IN THE SAME COLUMN FOR THE FIRST TIME AND ARE NOT IN THE SAME UNIT.**

**THE NINTH-DAY RETURNS.** The cycle is 298 plus nine. **THE FIFTEENTH WAS DAY 424 AND NINETY. THE SIXTEENTH IS DAY 433, A FRIDAY, AND IT IS NINETY-TWO HUNDREDWEIGHT, THE LARGEST OF THE ELEVEN. THE SEVENTEENTH IS DAY 442, A SUNDAY, AND IT IS EIGHTY-SEVEN HUNDREDWEIGHT, THE SMALLEST OF THE ELEVEN, AND IT WAS MADE TWO DAYS LATE, ON THE TWENTY-FOURTH AT ABOUT THE SECOND HOUR OF THE AFTERNOON, BECAUSE THE MAN WHO HOLDS THE FIFTH SHARE WAS ON ABOUT FOUR FEET OF GROUND IN THE MIDDLE OF ELEVEN ACRES FOR SEVENTEEN HOURS AND COULD NOT BRING A BARROW UP FOUR MILES IN RAIN, AND NOBODY ASKED HIM TO AND NOBODY IS GOING TO.** The two-day lateness was entered with the day and the hour on it and read back before a word of it went on the page, and no fault is entered. The seventeenth was brought by the man of about thirty-one of Silling, who asked to be allowed to take it and was allowed and was not thanked. **A NAME WENT INTO BY AND A NAME WENT INTO WITNESSED BY, AND THE SEVENTH PAIR IN ELEVEN YEARS IS THE FIRST IN WHICH THE FIRST NAME IS NOT A PERSON WHO CARRIES THE BARROW, and the seven at Silling decided it and not this holding.**

**HARLAN VETCH WROTE WET SEASON IN THE SECOND RULE ON THE THIRTEENTH OF THIS MONTH, IN HIS OWN HAND, WITHOUT BEING ASKED, FOR THE TENTH TIME IN ELEVEN YEARS, ONCE A YEAR SINCE HE TOOK THE SHARE.** The reader of this body asked him on the road whether he was going to write it, and he said he did not know, and was not asked again, and the reason is entered.

**THE SHELF WELL, FOUR HUNDRED MILES AND FOUR DAYS OFF. THE FOURTEENTH ORDINARY READING WAS TAKEN AT ABOUT THE FOURTH HOUR ON DAY 436, THE SIXTEENTH OF THIS MONTH, A MONDAY, BY THE OCCUPIER, IN HER OWN YARD, ON HER OWN WALL, AT THE LEVEL OF THE WATER AND NOT THE LEVEL OF THE CURE. THE DAY WAS ENTERED AND THE FIGURE WAS NOT, and the standing of the day and not the figure is three and was not reduced. THE WALL CARRIES THIRTEEN MARKS, BEING TWELVE FIGURES AND ONE GAP, AND WAS NOT ADDED TO AND NOT TAKEN FROM, and this holding's book holds four of the figures and all four of them are five feet, and the tenth is not in it and the occupier refused it in her own hand.** **THERE IS NO ENTRY ANYWHERE IN THIS HOLDING'S BOOK FOR THAT WELL COMING BACK AND NO CHAPTER OF THIS BATCH MADE ONE.**

**THE FOUR LINES AND THE CRATE, AND THE ROAD THEY CAME DOWN, EVERY DATE OF IT.** Four lines went **up** on day 432 at about the seventh hour with a hired rider at about two shillings and sixpence, carrying a request for one thing and naming no person. They were on the shelf at about the seventh hour of **day 436**, the same afternoon she took the fourteenth figure off her own wall, and the room was opened the same afternoon — **it was not locked, it has a hasp, and the key had been on her ring for eleven years and was taken off it and is in the crate** — and a rider took the crate down the same evening and it was in this holding's yard at about the seventh hour of the evening of **day 440**. The reading is on **day 441**. The crate went back up on day 443 at about the seventh hour. **THE FOUR LINES ARE ENTERED WHOLE IN CH 240 AND THE FOURTH OF THEM IS: PUT IT AGAINST WHOEVER IS GOING TO BE ON THE STONE. NOT AGAINST THE ONE WHO SENT FOR IT.** And the man of the north row with the cough had said on the Friday evening at the north gate that he was going to be on the stone and had a fifth in him that he did not put on the sheet, and he said it before the lines arrived, and the reader of this body entered that two people four hundred miles apart who have never met said the same thing about the same thing and that he is not going to say what that is. **She put no name on anything, and the fen entered that he is not going to put one on it and that anybody in about four years who wants a name on it can go and stand in that yard and ask her for it.**

**THE ANSWER FROM FENNEMERE, IN FOUR LINES, ENTERED WHOLE IN CH 243, WITH NO NAME AND NO OFFICE ON IT.** ONE. An answer given in a room binds upon the room. TWO. The ground named in the question is not a party to it and was not heard, and this room has no standing to make it a party, and this room does not propose to acquire one. THREE. A body that asked may put this answer in front of that ground, and that ground may refuse it, and if it refuses it this room will record the refusal and will not treat it as a failure of any process. FOUR. This room has no hold on a heartroot and has not sought one and is not aware of any instrument by which it could take one. **Four votes to none. The four are not counted.** **It is correct in all four lines, it answers a narrower question than the one that was asked, it does not lie and does not obstruct and does not delay and took about four months, and NOBODY HAS ASKED THAT ROOM A SECOND TIME, and it does not resolve who speaks for the eleven acres of standing willow and no chapter of this batch resolved it.** The question was: WHAT IS THE STANDING OF A BODY OF HOUSEHOLDS UPON A GROUND THAT IS NOT THEIRS, AND WHO ANSWERS FOR IT, AND IS AN ANSWER GIVEN IN A ROOM IN FENNEMERE BINDING UPON THE GROUND OR ONLY UPON THE ROOM.

**THE COVENANT OF SIX LINES, ENTERED WHOLE IN CH 244, READ OUT STANDING UP IN ABOUT NINETEEN PEOPLE AND READ BACK BY THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY, AND THE READER OF THIS BODY DID NOT HOLD IT AND WAS NOT ASKED TO.** ONE. The node is worked, not patterned, and the third clause of the Assembly is not met and is not pretended to be met. TWO. The fourth line is Marden's and is empty, and it is written here that it is empty, and nobody is to put a name in it until Marden asks for one, and Marden has not asked. THREE. A body of households may stop any turn of its own at any time, without saying why and without saying why before. FOUR. **A SEAT ON THIS ROTA IS NOT AN OFFICE. A SEAT may be refused by the person who holds it at any time, and nobody owns a seat on it, and the holding of a seat is not the holding of the node, and a body that refuses its own seat is not in arrears to anybody.** FIVE. The figure of what this node delivers is about fifteen hundred hundredweight a day and the figure of what four bodies of households count that they need is about two thousand one hundred, and the difference is six hundred hundredweight a day, and that figure is the same figure it was before this sheet was drawn, and this sheet does not change it. SIX. **Nobody is to be thanked for any part of this.**

**THE SIGNATURES: four, one objection under the sheet, one refusal to sign.** The old man of about seventy-four with a stick **refused the fifth line and signed the rest**, gave the arithmetic — a hundred and thirty-two months, thirty-day months, one turn in four, **nine hundred and ninety**, and there are **nine** — and said that a heading that is true about a bad year is still a true heading, and had his objection read out again in his own words after he had asked for that, and corrected no word of it. Soren Rill, of about thirty-five, of an Assembly in the Thornwild, **did not sign** and gave a reason about eleven acres of standing willow and the fact that the room at Fennmere has told them in writing it has no standing to make that ground a party. **THE OLD MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-FOUR WITH A STICK AND THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE OF AN ASSEMBLY IN THE THORNWILD REMAIN UNNAMED AND THE WORD *seat* APPEARS FIVE TIMES IN THE WHOLE BATCH AND ALL FIVE ARE ON ONE LINE, WHICH IS THE FOURTH LINE OF THE COVENANT.**

**THE VOLUME'S OWN QUESTION WAS ANSWERED, IN ONE PARAGRAPH, BY THE WOMAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-EIGHT OF MARDEN, IN ABOUT NINETEEN PEOPLE, WITH NO REASON GIVEN IN FRONT OF IT** — the only time in this holding's book that anybody has said a thing in a yard of about nineteen people with no reason in front of it. **WHAT A VILLAGE GIVES THE NODE IS THE MORNING AFTER ITS OWN. It is not water and it is not money and it is not a fifth launder, and it is not a thing anybody can put in a line with a number at the end of it, and it is the reason the fourth line has been empty nine mornings in twenty and it is not going to get better by writing a name in it.** She was not thanked and said before she began that anybody who thanked her could be told to stop.

**THE WORD *uneven* WAS SAID OUT LOUD ONCE, IN ABOUT NINETEEN PEOPLE, ON THE TWENTY-SEVENTH OF THIS MONTH, BY THE READER OF THIS BODY, AND ENTERED AS SAID ONCE, AND IS NOT GOING TO BE SAID AGAIN.** It appears four times in the batch in the plural and once as a bare noun and none of them improves on it. **THE FOUR LAUNDERS MEASURE NINE HUNDRED, SIX HUNDRED, NOTHING AND TWENTY-FIVE, THE LAUNDER THAT MEASURES NOTHING WAS CUT AT THE KERB ON THE ELEVENTH OF THE FIRST MONTH AND IS NOT HEALED, THE TWENTY-FIVE IS INSIDE SOMEBODY'S ABOUT, AND THE SHORTFALL IS SIX HUNDRED HUNDREDWEIGHT A DAY AND DID NOT GO UP AND DID NOT COME DOWN. A COVENANT IS NOT A FIGURE AND THIS ONE DOES NOT MAKE ONE.**

**THE PULSE. CH 245 ONLY, AND IT IS THE VOLUME'S LAST BEAT.** At about the fourth hour and forty minutes of the afternoon of the thirtieth of this month, and again at about the tenth hour of the evening of the same day, in daylight and in the dark, on the same sill, at the same place on the sill, about nine feet off the hollow, **the water on the west sill, which has moved about once in every four or five seconds from the west side for as long as anybody at that node has been putting a rule against it, moved about once in every second FOR ELEVEN SECONDS, both times, on the same stopwatch, with the same man on it and the same man calling it.** The interval from the first beginning to the second beginning is **six hours and eleven seconds.** **It came in on the north side: the north sill moved first and the west sill moved with it a half second after. There is no ground to the north of that node for about sixty miles and nobody has been asked, because there is nobody north of that node.** **IT WAS NOT READ A THIRD TIME. THE READER OF THIS BODY ENTERED THE TWO FIGURES AND IMPROVED NEITHER AND GAVE IT NO NAME, and said out loud that a thing that arrives at the same hour twice is not weather, that weather does not keep time, that it is a pulse, and that there is a thing coming in the next year and it is not his to fix. False Season is not named in this batch and may be named in a later one. The reader of this body put in his own book that the man of about fifty was at the seed house nine miles off at the first one and not what he says, because whatever he says is not a finding about this.**

7. **A FALSE CLEARANCE ABOUT THE CLOSED VOLUMES, CONTRADICTED BY THIS CLOSE'S OWN TWO RECORDS.** `state/current.md` asserted that every one of the five British forms had **zero** instances in the four closed volumes. **`judgement` stands ONCE in a closed volume**, at `workspace/volume-03/batch-0002/chapter-0116.md:46`, in the mouth of the man of about seventy: *neither of them is a judgement*. **And this file's mechanical check and open thread 47 in `state/open-threads.md` both already said that one instance remained.** **THREE OF THIS CLOSE'S OWN DOCUMENTS DID NOT AGREE WITH EACH OTHER ABOUT ONE COUNT, WHICH IS EXACTLY THE FAULT FINDING 4 OF THE VOLUME 04 CLOSE REVIEW NAMED AS THE MOST DANGEROUS WAY FOR A NUMBER TO BE WRONG, BECAUSE A CLOSE THAT TRUSTED TWO OF ITS OWN FILES WOULD HAVE CERTIFIED A CLEARANCE THAT WAS FALSE.** The claim of zero is withdrawn and replaced with the measured position: the other four forms have zero, `judgement` has one. **THE INSTANCE WAS NOT REPAIRED AND THE DISPOSITION IS THE POINT: a Volume 05 close may not edit a closed volume, so it is RECORDED, not cleaned, with its file, its line and its sentence now named in all three files so that a phase with the authority to touch a closed volume can reach it in one step.** It is the only instance in the 196 files of the four closed volumes, measured with a word boundary. **A CLOSE THAT HAD REPAIRED IT WOULD HAVE BEEN BETTER ON THE PAGE AND WORSE AS A RECORD, BECAUSE IT WOULD HAVE DONE A THING IT WAS FORBIDDEN TO DO AND HIDDEN IT INSIDE A SPELLING FIX.**

Both repaired — AND THE REPAIR WAS RIGHT WHILE THE ACCOUNT OF IT WAS WRONG TWICE OVER, because this pass named Ch 201, which contains no `recogniz*` at all, and it claimed the chapter did not contain the sentence, which it does. The errors were in the description of the fix and not in the fix, and they were caught only by a later reviewer who re-derived the chapter instead of taking this record's word for it, which is the argument of this whole pass applied against this pass.** Both word-neutral, and neither touches a figure, a day, a count, a name or a reading. **What remains of this class in the state layer is now either a withdrawal record deliberately naming an old form, which the house method requires, or ordinary editorial English about the review itself, and both were left alone** — the difference being that a state file which reproduces a sentence of the book is a copy of the book and one which merely talks about the review is not.

The new section carries the measured position with the wrong count and the wrong chapters withdrawn, **because a section written today out of a state file that has never been re-measured would have reproduced the very fault it exists to end.**

THE FIGURES A LATER PHASE MAY RELY ON ARE UNCHANGED BY THIS PASS, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF FINDING 4 ABOVE: the one clause of prose that was repaired was repaired without moving a single one of them.**

**AND THE RULE THIS PASS LEAVES BEHIND, WHICH IS THE SAME ONE IT KEEPS LEARNING.** **A REVIEW THAT NAMES A STALE FIGURE HAS NOT CLEARED THE FIGURES IT DID NOT NAME, AND A CLOSE'S OWN FILES CAN CONTRADICT EACH OTHER WHILE EVERY ONE OF THEM IS CONFIDENT.** Both happened here, in the same phase, on the same day: a stale figure in a second and a third section that a reviewer had explicitly declared clean, and a false clearance about the closed volumes that two of the close's own documents had already contradicted. **THE TEST FOR BOTH IS THE SAME AND IT IS ONE COMMAND: MEASURE THE FILES AGAIN INSTEAD OF READING THE RECORD ABOUT THE FILES. A COUNT IN THIS REPOSITORY IS A MEASUREMENT OR IT IS NOTHING.**

## THE REVIEW OF THIS PASS, AND THE THREE THINGS IT FOUND INSIDE IT

**A REVIEWER WAS RUN OVER THE REPAIR PASS AND FOUND THREE MORE DEFECTS INSIDE THE PASS'S OWN SCOPE, PLUS TWO FAULTS IN THE PASS'S OWN ACCOUNT OF ITSELF. ALL FIVE ARE NOW CLOSED. THE MOST SERIOUS IS THE FIRST, AND IT IS NOT A REGRESSION: IT IS A DEFECT THE CLOSE CREATED, LEFT STANDING, AND THEN RECORDED AS REPAIRED.**

### 1. THE CLOSE REPAIRED ONE OF TWO SITES OF THE SAME FACT AND RECORDED THAT IT REPAIRED BOTH

**Ch 239:27, the man of the north row with the cough, on the Sunday evening: *If it is four inches a day then in three days it is going to be a foot.* Four inches for three days is twelve inches, and the sum is exact. Ch 242:29 reports THE SAME MAN saying THE SAME SENTENCE to the reader of this body alone on THE SAME SUNDAY EVENING, with *nine days* in place of *three*, and four inches for nine days is thirty-six inches and is three feet.** The close changed nine to three in Ch 239, quoted the Ch 242 form as the instance in `reviews/volume-05.findings.md`, and its own `state/current.md` then wrote that the sum was repaired *to the smallest change that makes the sum exact* — **which was true of Ch 239 and false of the chapter that carries the climax, and the false half was in the file a next writer reads first.** **Ch 242:29 now reads *in three days it is going to be a foot*. The change is word-neutral, so Ch 242 stays at 3,098, Batch 0005 at 27,870, Volume 05 at 144,846 and the manuscript at 737,365, all four re-measured, and the two chapters now report one utterance with one number.** **THE OPEN FAMILY IS NOT TOUCHED AND IS STILL OPEN**, exactly as the close left it and with its numbers: the rate of about four inches a morning against a measured total of a foot and one inch over eight mornings. This repair is of a *forecast*, and it does not reconcile the rate against the total, and it was never meant to and does not pretend to.

**AND THE GENERAL RULE, WHICH IS THE ONE THIS VOLUME KEEPS HAVING TO LEARN: WHEN ONE FACT APPEARS IN TWO CHAPTERS, A REPAIR OF IT IS NOT FINISHED UNTIL BOTH SITES HAVE BEEN LOOKED AT, AND A CLOSE THAT REPAIRS ONE SITE AND RECORDS THAT IT REPAIRED THE FACT HAS PRODUCED SOMETHING WORSE THAN THE ORIGINAL ERROR, BECAUSE THE RECORD IS NOW BELIEVED AND THE SECOND SITE IS NO LONGER GOING TO BE LOOKED FOR.**

### 2. THE THIRD UNDER-SCOPING: `defence`, EIGHT TIMES IN A CLOSED VOLUME

**The close swept the closed volumes for the five British forms this volume happened to contain, certified the other four as absent, and missed the largest family in the set. `defence` stands EIGHT times in closed Volume 04** — `chapter-0182.md:25`, `:31`, `:63`, `chapter-0185.md:34`, `chapter-0193.md:49`, `:69`, `chapter-0194.md:39`, `chapter-0196.md:69` — against a bible that mandates *defense*, **and it is a form this repository already sweeps for by name, having been listed in Volume 02's thirty-form sweep and repaired there.** **So the closed volumes carry at least nine British instances across two families and thirteen chapters, and no state file said so. THE DISPOSITION IS THE SAME AS `judgement`'s AND FOR THE SAME REASON: a Volume 05 close may not edit a closed volume, so all nine sites are RECORDED, not cleaned, with their files and their lines now named in this file, in `state/current.md` and in open thread 47 in `state/open-threads.md`, so that a phase with the authority to touch a closed volume reaches every one of them in one step.** *favour* at fourteen and *licence* at twenty-four in the closed volumes were re-measured by this pass and both stand; a reviewer who returned twenty-three had counted Volume 04 alone, the true distribution being one in Volume 03 and twenty-three in Volume 04.

**THE RULE: A SWEEP FOR THE FORMS A VOLUME HAPPENED TO CONTAIN IS NOT A SPELLING AUDIT. A CLOSE THAT REPAIRS WHAT IT FOUND AND THEN CERTIFIES THE REST HAS CERTIFIED A LIST AND NOT A VOLUME, AND THE LIST IS ALWAYS THE LIST OF WHAT WAS LOOKED FOR.**

### 3. A THIRD STALE LIVE CLAIM, IN THE CLASS THIS PASS WAS CLEANING, STANDING FOR FIVE PASSES

**`state/current.md` said, in bold, that `workspace/volume-05/batch-0005/` CARRIES NO MARKER AND IS IN FLIGHT. `batch-0005/.done` EXISTS, the batch is finished and the close has run, so the claim is false twice over.** Corrected to the measured position — `batch-0001/` through `batch-0005/` all carry `.done`, `volume-close/` carries none — **with NO MARKER CREATED, DELETED OR MOVED TO CORRECT IT AND NONE PERMITTED TO BE. The markers and the selection logic are controller-owned, and a writer's duty on finding one of these is to record what it found and change nothing. This is the second time this volume a marker claim in this file was found false, and the first time it was found in the same direction, which is that a finished thing was described as in flight; the earlier one was the `.wip-conflict` that had already been renamed.**

### 4. AND TWO FAULTS IN THE PASS'S OWN ACCOUNT OF ITSELF

**It named Ch 201 where the British form in `state/chapter-summaries.md` is in the Ch 197 summary, and it claimed the chapter did not contain the sentence when Ch 197:49 does contain it in the correct US form. The repair was right; the description of the repair was wrong twice over. It also wrote *the five that moved and the eight that did not*, which was never a figure — it conflated the batch's narrative headings with its word-count table, and the table at 4225-4234 shows NINE of the ten recorded figures wrong and ONE right, that one being Ch 202, running low in seven cases and high in two, for 138 words. And it claimed the new Batch 0001 section was measured throughout, when the seven card-versus-page deviations and the six sites rewritten in drafting are not measurable from the chapter files at all; both are now marked as carried rather than measured.** All three corrected in `state/current.md` and here.

**THE RULE THIS ADDS, AND IT IS THE SAME RULE THE FIRST ONE IS: A RECORDING OF A REPAIR IS ITSELF A CLAIM ABOUT THE WORLD, AND A RECORD THAT MISDESCRIBES ITS OWN REPAIR PUTS ONE GENERATION OF ERROR BETWEEN A DEFECT AND THE PERSON WHO WOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT. THE ONLY DEFENCE AVAILABLE IS TO RE-DERIVE AND NOT TO BELIEVE, WHICH IS WHAT THE REVIEWER DID AND WHAT THIS FILE ASKS OF EVERY LATER PHASE IN EVERY ONE OF THESE SECTIONS. IT IS ALSO THE SUBJECT OF THE VOLUME ITSELF: A MAN WHO WRITES A THING DOWN WRONG, AND A ROOM THAT BELIEVES HIM, AND WHAT THAT COSTS.**

## THE REVIEW OF THE SECOND ROUND, AND THE FOURTH UNDER-SCOPING

**A SECOND REVIEWER WAS RUN OVER THE SECOND ROUND AND FOUND THE FOURTH UNDER-SCOPING, WHICH IS THE ONE THAT WAS WORTH LOOKING FOR: the spelling sweep was aimed at the five forms this volume happened to contain, and it had been applied to a family in a volume nobody may touch while being skipped in the one everybody may. Five further items, three of them faults in the second round's own account of itself, are closed with it.**

### 1. THREE BRITISH FORMS WERE STANDING IN VOLUME 05 ITSELF

**`mould`, seven sites — Chs 208 (twice), 216, 219, 222, 234 (twice) — and `plough` and `ploughing`, two sites, at Ch 205:71 and Ch 225:53. Every one has ZERO instances in the four closed volumes and appears nowhere in `bible/terminology.md` or in `outline/volume-05.md`, so the argument that saved `favour` and `licence` — that a fifth volume must not be made to disagree with four — does not apply to them by a single instance. They were violations of the bible in the one volume the close had authority over, standing unrepaired and recorded in no file, and they are now `mold`, `plow` and `plowing`. The changes are one word for one word and the chapter and volume figures are unchanged, re-measured after the edit.**

### 2. `curb` AND `kerb`, AND AN OBJECT SPELLED BOTH WAYS INSIDE ONE CHAPTER

**`curb` stood five times in three chapters — Ch 207:75, Ch 224:33, Ch 239:51 and :69 — against `kerb` in thirty-one of the forty-nine chapters, so Ch 224 carried `curb` at :33 and `kerb` at :27 and :53, and Ch 239 carried `kerb` at :5 and `curb` at :51 and :69. The same object had two spellings in the same chapter. The five are repaired to `kerb`, which is the majority and the form `outline/volume-05.md` uses. `kerb` ITSELF IS NOT REPAIRED AND IS RECORDED OPEN AT NINETY-FOUR SITES: it is the volume's core noun, and normalising ninety-four lines across a volume whose outline already spells it that way is a volume-level decision for a phase with that authority, not a close-pass repair. Recording it is the honest disposition. Sweeping it inside a repair pass would have been a fifth large act taken without authority, and the next writer would have inherited it as a fait accompli rather than as a decision.**

### 3. AND THREE FAULTS IN THE SECOND ROUND'S OWN ACCOUNT OF ITSELF

**It asserted that Volume 05's prose carried ZERO British spellings, sixty lines after this same file recorded that `favour` (eleven) and `licence` (four) stand in it deliberately and on the record — so the file that had just diagnosed *three documents of one close disagreeing about a count* reproduced that exact fault one level up. It wrote that the new Batch 0001 section's carried items were *marked as carried where they appear* when they were not, which is a claim of completed work inside the correction of a claim of uncompleted work. And it explained a reviewer's `licence` figure of twenty-three as *counting lines and not occurrences*, which is arithmetically impossible, because Volume 04's line count is twenty-one: the reviewer counted Volume 04 alone, and the closed-volume total is twenty-four. All three are corrected. The guardrail verdict that read *the thirteenth, US spelling, was broken and is repaired* is replaced by one that distinguishes the twenty-two named forms, the two deliberate ones, the three found since and the one open, because as a live status the old sentence was false.**

### 4. AND THE ONE NUMBER IN THE CLOSE'S RECORD THAT CANNOT BE VERIFIED AT ALL

**`reviews/volume-05.findings.md` gives the five forms as 3 + 3 + 5 + 10 + 2, which is twenty-three, and calls the total twenty-two; its own itemised chapter list runs to twenty-four sites across sixteen chapters.** Both totals are now withdrawn in that file, the sixteen chapters are named, and the figure a later phase may rely on is **the zero that remains and not either total, because the text they measured no longer exists and the repair is the point.** This is worth stating plainly: it is the only number in the whole volume-close record that cannot be checked by any command, and the correct disposition for an unverifiable number is to withdraw it and say why, and not to pick the likelier of the two.

**THE RULE THIS ROUND ADDS, AND IT IS THE FOURTH TIME THE SAME RULE HAS BEEN LEARNED IN ONE VOLUME: THE THING A SWEEP FINDS IS A FUNCTION OF WHAT IT LOOKED FOR, AND A SWEEP FOR THE FORMS A VOLUME HAPPENED TO CONTAIN WILL FIND THOSE FORMS AND REPORT THE VOLUME CLEAN. THIS ROUND APPLIED THE PRINCIPLE TO A FAMILY IN A VOLUME IT COULD NOT TOUCH AND SKIPPED IT IN THE VOLUME IT COULD, WHICH IS THE SAME ERROR AS THE FIRST THREE WITH THE SCOPE REVERSED. THE TEST THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT ALL FOUR IS ONE LINE AND IT IS NOT A SPELLING TEST BUT A QUESTION: NOT *DOES MY LIST FIND ANYTHING* BUT *WHY IS MY LIST THIS LIST*.**

The figures **eleven seconds and six hours and eleven seconds**, and *the office holds the same figures and does not propose to alter them*. **The maintained season**, and *the maintained season is a term of this office and not of the district*, and *the office does not state on paper what the operation consists of on the ground.* Compensation at **one shilling and twopence the hundredweight** for one season against a flow a body of households has counted as its own and is able to show a figure for, applications received at the district town and answered in the order received. **The maintenance will be reviewed before the next window.** At the foot, over an acknowledgment line for a person to sign, **CHANCELLOR IONA VEY, OFFICE OF THE CONTINUITY**, and the line names **MAREK VALE, ENGINEER OF RECORD, LANTERN REACH WORK COOPERATIVE**. **THE LINE WAS NOT SIGNED AND WAS NOT REFUSED OUT LOUD AND THE REASON WAS NOT ENTERED, because a reason would have been a figure and there is no figure.**

A FROST CAME ON THE SIXTH AT ABOUT THE FIFTH HOUR AND HELD UNTIL ABOUT THE EIGHTH, THIN, IN THE FURROWS AND THE RUTS AND THE SHADOW SIDE OF EVERY POST, AND NOT ON THE ROAD, AND THE SKY WAS CLEAR AT THE FOURTH HOUR AND AT THE FIFTH.** The trough had ice in it twice this month, on the second and on the sixth. **A FROST IN THE FOURTH MONTH IS A FIGURE AND NOT A CAUSE.**
- **THE RING OF BARE GROUND** is about two yards wide and about two hundred yards long, nine feet off the hollow, bare eleven years, and it is walked at the shoulder in Ch 246 and in Ch 251 and is not stopped at and not measured and not asked about, and **it is two professionals in this holding's history who have walked past it and written down that they do not know what it is doing there and a third is to come in about four years.**
- **THE COST OF THE WEEK, all entered, none of it in the compost line.** A hired horse for the cart road, two days east and one day back, **two shillings and eightpence.** Eleven reed mats and four mats over nine seed beds in an hour and ten minutes, **eleven pounds and four shillings.** A letter to the Rootwright Assembly, **eleven pence.** Three ditches and a frost and a gate.

## THE NINE, AND WHAT EACH ONE WAS

**1. `chapter-0311.md`, FORWARD IMPORT. The man of about fifty read out on the day-522 morning the span that belongs to day 525: seventy-five and seventy-three, and *the ten figures in it*. THE CHAPTER'S OWN SERIES COUNT AT `:13` IS SEVENTY-TWO AND ITS OWN AGGREGATE IS SEVENTY, SO THE THREE FIGURES WERE WRONG INSIDE THEIR OWN SERIES AND WERE REPAIRED TO seventy-two, seventy AND seven. THE THREE ADJACENT COUNTS OF THE SAME SPAN WERE REPAIRED WITH THEM, being *the seven days* at `:35` and *any of the seven mornings* at `:49` and in the clerk's entry, because a repair that leaves ten standing beside a seven has made a new seam.**

**2. `chapter-0313.md`, A CHAPTER THAT CONTRADICTS ITSELF ON ONE COUNT. ## WHAT THE VOLUME WAS ABOUT

**WHO GETS TO DECIDE WHAT A BRIDGE CONNECTS.** Not who owns a road, not who holds a schedule, not who can issue the paper: who decides, when two pieces of ground are eleven hundred yards apart and the people on the far one have never been asked, what the thing between the two of them is for. **The volume's answer is that a bridge is made of two ends and the two ends are held by people and the people can say no, and that the refusing is not a failure of the bridge.** It proves that in the only way the book knows how, which is not by argument and not by a victory and not by a door closing, but by a bridge that runs, a sheet that claims it correctly, a body of households that declines the claim and not the bridge, an Assembly that declines five sentences as offered, and two questions asked out loud at the end and answered by nobody.

## THE CENTRAL PRESSURE, AND HOW IT WAS RESOLVED

**Thornwild is severed and its seed is running out, and the thing that would reconnect it is a document the office will not write.** The memorandum of protection of the twentieth of the fifth says at its eleventh line that no sequence, no part containing a sequence, and no cradle, is to be removed, broken, opened or set against any valve by any person without a written instrument of the office named at the head of it. **Over fifty-one mornings nobody asked for that paper once, and no such instrument was issued, received, invented, hinted at or worked around, and the living control seed on the middle table of a seed house was never looked at, lifted, opened, broken or set against anything, and the count of people who have looked at it is two and did not move on any of the fifty-one.** The bridge was built without it.

**And it was resolved by a refusal that arrives after the bridge is already running, which is the only resolution this book's argument permits.** On the second of the seventh a man stood at the edge of a ring of bare ground and refused a shorter road, giving the reason first, and the day and a half of walking that the shortcut was worth was written on a day sheet as a deliberate gap with a date on it and no why on it, and the man of about fifty said out loud that a gap with nothing in it looks exactly like an oversight and that he was writing it deliberately. **The route went the long way round. The bridge ran on the twelfth of the seventh for about nine minutes with a man of about sixty-eight at the far end against a wall four hundred yards from a building with no roof, and he was not asked whether he would, and he could not walk out of the ground afterwards, and nobody thanked him, and he said in advance in his own house that he would not be thanked and would like it not done in a yard.** Then the corridor was claimed on paper, correctly, by an office that lied about nothing; a body of households declined the claim and not the bridge; the five public terms were declined as offered, all five, with no part named; and a corridor opened anyway in a room of nine under three refusals and one decision.

## WHAT IT COST

**A day and a half of walking, and about four days of somebody else's seed, and about nine minutes of a man of sixty-eight who could not walk out of the ground afterwards.** **The whole cost of the volume is those three things and they were never converted into one another on any of the fifty-one mornings: sacks are not days and days are not sacks, and the day and a half is ours and the four days is theirs, and there is no column on that table that takes both at once.** A hundred and fifty pounds of a store was asked for twice and never answered, and the four days came off a rack in a room with a stone floor in a number of sacks that this holding does not have and has refused to be given, and the man of about fifty wrote the word *sacks* in a column and left it there.

## THE SHAPE OF THE FIVE MOVEMENTS

**MOVEMENT 1, CHAPTERS 295 TO 304, DAYS 506 TO 515, *WHAT HAS TO BE ASKED*.** A volume opens on a refusal. A seed store is described from the inside by a woman who has stood in it and there is no figure of it in this holding's book and there is not going to be one. Two terms go on a table, one of which is NO CONVERSION, and an Assembly declines to be entered in a schedule at all with the reason given first and nobody improves it. The key goes from a cloth to a hand, the question count stays nil, and the window opens on the sixth and shuts on the eleventh with nothing carried out of it.
**MOVEMENT 2, CHAPTERS 305 TO 314, DAYS 516 TO 525, *THE OFFICE, THE WINDOW, AND A PERSON WHO IS NOT NAMED*.** Six days, a person appointed to be present who cannot say who appointed them and is not a steward, a one-page form that is correct in every particular and is not an instrument, a long fungal found inside four hundred yards of the first dwelling and not inside the inhabited line, a corridor in the pan that is open and is not a road, and the standing rule about the engineer of record named in full and not used.
**MOVEMENT 3, CHAPTERS 315 TO 324, DAYS 526 TO 535, *WHAT A CONNECTION CARRIES*.** The volume's turn. The well on the shelf is read as a day and not a figure and the count of those goes four to five. A short connection is made on the eighteenth and it works, in ordinary words, for about four minutes, and what it costs is on the page in three figures and one this holding cannot put a figure on at all. The blight is inside the inhabited line of Thornwild seven days later and nobody can prove it came through the connection and nobody can prove it did not. Stage 6 is reached in a room. And an Assembly asks a question that is not about water.
**MOVEMENT 4, CHAPTERS 325 TO 334, DAYS 536 TO 545, *THE TERMS, IN TWO HANDS AND A THIRD*.** Five terms, one of them in the man of about fifty's own hand and not a term anybody else would have written; Tova Reed and Soren Rill refuse the fifth in a room with the reason first in both cases and a different reason in each, and the refusal stands and the term is not withdrawn. A warden is in a room once, is right about a danger and wrong about who decides, and signs an order sealing the route. The engineer's name is said out loud in a yard once, by a person who was not asked to and did not know. The nine acres of Marden come off and the decision of the eleventh of the fourth is not reopened by a bridge existing. And the shortcut is priced in days and refused on the ground.
**MOVEMENT 5, CHAPTERS 335 TO 343, DAYS 546 TO 556, *THE BRIDGE BELOW, AND THE CORRIDOR*.** Climax and resolution together, nine chapters across eleven days, with Chapters 338 and 340 each carrying two days, and zero `Entered` blocks in all nine, which is the inverse of Volume 06's Batch 0005 and is deliberate. The long way round is settled in a room with the reason first. The thing under the cloth is not opened, in about nine people, out loud. The north row is walked to and three questions about furniture are asked instead of whether he will help. A number of sacks arrives that nobody asked for and is not converted. The bridge runs. It stands three mornings with nobody in charge of it. It is claimed, correctly. It is not claimed, correctly. And a corridor opens under vetoes in a holding with no charter, and a form from an office that keeps a register of persons who may set a sequence against a valve goes on the middle table and is not filled.

## THE TEN THINGS THE VOLUME DID THAT A READER WILL STILL HAVE IN A YEAR

**ONE. IT BUILT A BRIDGE AND THEN LET IT BE UNCLAIMED, AND THE LETTING IS THE ARGUMENT.** Nine minutes, two people at two ends, and three mornings afterwards in which nobody knows whether the eleven hundred yards are connected and nobody in this holding has an instrument that says. **A bridge nobody can refuse is a pipe, and the proof is not an argument, and a volume whose whole case is about consent ends by making its own central object unmeasurable on purpose.**
**TWO. IT SAID NO CONVERSION AND THEN PAID FOR IT.** Tova Reed wrote a term in a room on the twenty-seventh of the fifth about paying in the unit a thing is paid in. Thirty-five days later a woman of about sixty and a man of about forty counted sacks out loud in a room with a stone floor and argued about whether it was four days or five, and the column that wanted a weight got the word *sacks* and nothing else, and the four days went into the ground and are not coming back. **A term is worth what it costs to keep, and this one cost four days of somebody else's year, and the volume says so on the page four times.**
**THREE. IT HAD A MAN GIVE HIS ROOM, A BOARD, A SILL AND A HAND AND NOT BE THANKED, AND IT ASKED HIM ABOUT FURNITURE.** The engineer of record walked half a mile in the wet, stood on the step for the length of two coughs, and did not ask whether the man would help, because every sentence he had written for the walk had the word *will* in it and a will is a question. **Then he told him which end of a thing he was, and asked him three things about a table, and went away, and a man of about sixty-eight wrote three inches on a sheet of his own in his own hand and it was not read by anybody.**
**THREE AGAIN, BECAUSE IT IS THE BEST OF THEM: IT LET THE HOLDING BE WRONG IN THE BOOK AND SAID SO OUT LOUD.** A gap in a day sheet with a date on it and no why on it, because a gap with nothing in it looks exactly like an oversight. A column that has a heading and no unit, kept for four years on purpose, by a man who says out loud that a name over an empty place makes a place sound answered. A standing that a room reads out loud for nine minutes and improves in no part.
**FOUR. IT NAMED A CORRIDOR IN A ROOM OF NINE, UNDER REFUSALS, AND SAID THAT NAMING IT IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING ANSWERED.** *A corridor that opens under three refusals and one decision is not a corridor that has been answered, and the three refusals stand where they were put and the decision is in a room of nine in a holding with no charter and it is not the same kind of object as either of those.*
**FIVE. IT HAD A CORRECT DOCUMENT AS THE DANGEROUS ONE AND SAID SO.** A sheet on district paper saying no, correctly, about an office that is not even theirs. A claim on a corridor, every particular right, that cannot be put down by anybody, because *you would have to put down the ground, or the cut, or the fact that two people held a pattern on Friday morning*. And a register form that is a column and wants a name in it, and the count of persons in this fen who may set a sequence against a valve is one and he is not going to write it down.
**SIX. IT SPENT FOUR DAYS OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S SEED ON A BRIDGE AND DID NOT CALL IT SPENT.** *I am not going to put the word spent on them, because a word like that on a figure somebody else gave us is a thing we do to them.*
**SEVEN. IT DID NOT THANK THE MAN WHO HELD THE FAR END AND SAID OUT LOUD, BEFOREHAND, THAT IT WOULD NOT.** And it entered that the nine minutes enter neither his count of yards nor his count of silences, that holding a pattern is not standing in a yard, and that the nine minutes are a figure about a bridge and are not a figure about what he will be able to do in about four years, and nobody asked him that either and he would like nobody to.
**EIGHT. IT LET AN ASSEMBLY DECLINE FIVE SENTENCES AS OFFERED AND DID NOT LET ANYBODY IMPROVE THE DECLINING.** And the answer it gave for the not-answering is the sharpest sentence in the volume: *a body that has been asked which of five sentences it did not like has been asked a different question from the one you sent, and the answer to the different question is worse for you than the answer you got.*
**NINE. IT SAID THE NAME ONCE, IN A YARD, IN AN ORDINARY SENTENCE ABOUT A DYKE, AND REFUSED TO MAKE IT AN EVENT.** A man who interrupts an ordinary sentence to say that his name has not been said out loud in a yard in four years has made his name into an event, and an event is what a name is not supposed to be in a yard at about the sixth hour on a Thursday.
**TEN. IT PLANTED THE OFFICE THAT WOULD MAKE AN OFFER AND DID NOT CLIMB THE LADDER.** A register of persons who may set a sequence against a valve, read out whole, not filled, put on the middle table and not in the drawer, and a man saying out loud that a sheet with a no on it is not an offer and a form with four lines is not an offer and a memorandum of protection is not an offer, and that a man with four documents in a drawer and no offer in any of them is a man who has never been made one, and that those are different and only one of them is anybody's fault.

## THE TWELVE THINGS THE VOLUME REFUSED TO DO, AND THIS IS THE LONGER HALF

**ONE. IT DID NOT USE THE SEED.** Not looked at, lifted, opened, broken, or set against any valve, on any of fifty-one mornings, and the count of people who have looked at it is two and did not move.
**TWO. IT DID NOT ASK FOR THE INSTRUMENT, AND NO INSTRUMENT CAME, AND NEITHER FACT WAS DRAMATISED.** A request was written out in one hand in four lines and not sent; a second request went on the ordinary post by a man who told the room afterwards with the reason first; what came back was a form, and then a sheet, and neither was an instrument.
**THREE. IT DID NOT WALK, MEASURE, CROSS, PRICE BY WALKING, OR EXPLAIN THE RING OF BARE GROUND.** It is bare in its eleventh year and it has no dimension anywhere in forty-nine chapters, and the only quantity attached to it is the day and a half that the going round it costs, and the man who refused it stood at the edge of it and said he had no view about why it was bare and was not going to acquire one.
**FOUR. IT DID NOT WALK THE CORRIDOR IN THE PAN.** It is named, in about nine people, as a migration and trade corridor, and nobody in this holding has ever walked it and the reader of this body said so out loud a month before and said he was not going to.
**FIVE. IT DID NOT PUT ANYTHING IN THE TWO-FOOT GAP AND THE CUT STAYS OPEN, AND THE FIFTEEN WORDS ARE QUOTED EXACTLY ONCE, IN CH 343, IN THOSE FIFTEEN WORDS AND NO OTHERS.**
**SIX. IT DID NOT THANK ANYBODY, FORGIVE ANYBODY, OR PUT ANYTHING TENDER ON THE PAGE.** `forgiv` is zero in forty-nine chapters; `tender` is three and all three are *nothing tender*; the phrase *he was not thanked and did not ask to be* is attached to every speech in the volume.
**SEVEN. IT DID NOT MOVE A SINGLE LOCK.** The use log stayed at fifteen. The pattern-holder counts stayed at two and one. The rootmarks stayed at two. The four accounts of the arm stayed at four. The six blank columns stayed blank and headed nothing. The seventh column stood at fifty and was read on four mornings and no others. The wall at the well on the shelf carried fourteen marks. The pulse was not read a third time and was not named. The not knowns stayed at six with no unit supplied for any. The two numbers this holding cannot check stayed at two. The bodies at the node stayed at five. The questions available to a room stayed at ten and were not said in a yard.
**EIGHT. IT DID NOT ANSWER WHOSE ORDER IT WAS, AND DID NOT ASK IT A FIFTH TIME, AND DID NOT USE THE WORD ORDER OF ANYBODY'S INSTRUCTION.** The word is used of the instrument a warden signed and of nothing else.
**NINE. IT DID NOT SAY ANYTHING ABOUT WHETHER THE TELLING IS STILL GOING ON.** The phrase does not occur in forty-nine chapters.
**TEN. IT DID NOT SAY WHETHER THE FRUITING BODIES ARE SAFE TO EAT, AND NOBODY PUT ONE IN A MOUTH, AND NOT ONE PIECE OF THE FUNGUS CAME INTO THIS HOLDING IN SIX MONTHS.**
**ELEVEN. IT DID NOT SAY WHETHER THE FRUITING BODIES' COUNT, OR WHO IS AT THE FAR END OF THE CONNECTION, OR WHO HOLDS THE PEN, OR WHAT THE FIFTH KIND OF CONTACT IS, OR WHAT THE PULSE IS, OR WHAT THE SIXTH COLUMN COUNTS.** The questions at the far end stay nil and nil and did not move on any of the six mornings they were named in this batch, and the whole volume is built on a man declining to ask them.
**TWELVE. IT DID NOT ANSWER THE QUESTION IT ASKED TWICE.** *Is an order a warden signed a thing that the people at both ends of a bridge may say no to?* Asked out loud at `chapter-0341.md:63` on the fourteenth of the seventh, and again at `chapter-0343.md:53` on the sixteenth, by the same man, in the same room, and answered by nobody on either afternoon, and the man of about fifty and the reader of this body each refused to answer it on the first, out loud, with a reason. **The volume asked its own central question out loud on the last two mornings of the book and left it in the room, and the third question is a question and not a thing with a shape.**

## THE LAST CHAPTER AND THE LAST LINE, AND WHY IT IS NOT AN ANSWER

**The last chapter is Ch 343, *A Corridor, Under Vetoes*, carrying day 556, the sixteenth of the seventh, a Tuesday, fifty-one days after the volume opened on a Monday.** The last word of the volume is **answer**, and it is the last word of the last sentence: **"No office in the world has answered it and nobody in this holding has asked anybody to answer."**

**That line is not an answer because the sentence is about what has not happened, twice, and the volume's third question is the one nobody asked.** The corridor that the sentence is about is named in the same chapter and the same afternoon, in a room of nine, over ground nobody has spoken for, under the refusal of a body of households that has not been withdrawn and under a decision of a body of households that has not been reopened. The question in the chapter — whether a sealing order is a thing the people at both ends of a bridge may say no to — was asked for the second time ninety minutes earlier and got nothing, and the sentence that ends the book is a denial of authority rather than a settlement of the question, and a book whose argument is that a correct claim cannot be put down does not get to end by putting one down. **It is the only ending this book has: the volume closes on the shape of the thing it refuses to answer.**

## WHERE THE VOLUME'S THREE QUESTIONS STAND

**QUESTION ONE, CARRIED AND ANSWERED NEVER, WHOSE ORDER IT IS.** Asked four times across the series, not asked a fifth time in Volume 07, named once without being asked, and answered in none of forty-nine chapters. **It stands exactly where it stood at day 505.**
**QUESTION TWO, CARRIED AND UNTOUCHED FOR THREE VOLUMES, IS THE TELLING STILL GOING ON.** The phrase does not occur in Volume 07. **It stands exactly where it stood.**
**QUESTION THREE, NEW IN THIS VOLUME: WHO GETS TO DECIDE WHAT A BRIDGE CONNECTS.** **The volume did not answer it and says so twice.** A sheet claims the corridor and is right, and cannot be put down. A body of households declines the claim and not the bridge. Five terms are declined as offered. And the question that would settle it is asked out loud on the last two mornings and answered in neither, and the man who asks it says on the page that he is not going to let it be a thing that got asked twice and answered never because a month turned over. **The volume's answer is that the deciding was done by people who were asked, and this holding's book has no column for the answer and did not have one before, and the last chapter says so without pretending that is an answer.**

## THE ENDING LOCK, RESTATED FROM `outline/ending.md` SO THAT A LATER PHASE CANNOT MOVE IT

**THE FINAL VOLUME IS CHAPTERS 736 TO 780, WITH THE IMMEDIATE CLIMAX IN CHAPTERS 756 TO 773 AND A FULL AFTERMATH THROUGH 780. THE FINAL EXTERNAL CONFLICT IS THE WHITE MERCY. THE FINAL INTERNAL CHOICE IS A REFUSAL OF PERMANENT CUSTODY, NOT A DESTRUCTION OF THE ENGINE. FOUR THINGS ARE PERMANENTLY LOST AND ARE NOT A FIGURE ANY PASS MAY REDUCE: Marek can no longer read the Deep Archive as a single private field or summon a unified response; the anchors receive a maintenance signal and not a piece of his mind, and each can disconnect without his permission; Tova's hearing remains partially damaged from the memory work in Volume 08; and Marek can never again revisit the specific Aldren memory he surrendered in Volume 13. IONA IS NOT KILLED. SHE IS CUT OFF FROM THE ENGINE AND PLACED UNDER PUBLIC CUSTODY, AND SHE REMAINS ALIVE AND RESPONSIBLE AND ABLE TO ANSWER. NO NEW FINAL ENEMY WAS INTRODUCED IN VOLUME 07 AND NONE MAY BE.**

## THE THREE DEBTS, REPORTED AND PAID NONE, AND ONE OF THE THREE IS WITHDRAWN

**ONE. `chapter-0331.md:19` SAYS *at a place five days east of this gate* in a chapter whose own line `:21` has the man there on the second morning having gone up on the first and come back down.** The fix is *a day's walk east of this gate*, three words for two, in a closed batch. **REPORTED AND UNPAID.**
**TWO. `outline/volume-07.md:39` AND `outline/volume-07.md:202` CARRY *five days east of the fen gate by cart road*,** in a completed phase's file. **REPORTED AND UNPAID. AND THE FIGURE IS BIGGER THAN THE RECORD SAYS, AND A REVIEW RE-MEASURED IT: *FIVE DAYS* IN THE SENSE THIS DEBT IS ABOUT — A DISTANCE, *A PLACE FIVE DAYS OFF* OR *FIVE DAYS EAST OF THIS GATE* — STANDS IN ELEVEN PROSE SITES IN FIVE CHAPTERS ACROSS THREE BATCHES: `chapter-0312.md:29` AND `:47` (BATCH 0002), `chapter-0321.md:25`, `:33` AND `:45` (BATCH 0003), `chapter-0329.md:53`, `chapter-0330.md:35` AND `chapter-0331.md:19`, `:31`, `:53` AND `:57` (BATCH 0004), AND WITH THE TWO PLACES IN THE OUTLINE THAT IS THIRTEEN PLACES IN ALL. THE WITHDRAWN FIGURES ARE *SEVEN PROSE SITES IN THREE CHAPTERS*, WHICH ITS OWN LIST OF EIGHT SITES IN FOUR CHAPTERS CONTRADICTED, AND *NINE PLACES AND NOT THREE*, WHICH ITS OWN LIST OF TEN CONTRADICTED, AND NEITHER IS REPAIRED BY SILENCE. THE MISS WAS ENTIRELY IN BATCH 0003: `chapter-0321.md` CARRIES THREE OF THE ELEVEN AND DID NOT APPEAR IN ANY LIST, AND THAT IS THE WORST OF THE THREE OMISSIONS BECAUSE IT IS THE ONE THAT MAKES A REPAIR PASS UNDER-COUNT THE BATCHES IT HAS TO OPEN. THE LAST PASS REACHED ONE SITE OF ELEVEN AND RECORDED ONE. AND THE FOUR USES OF THE SAME TWO WORDS THAT ARE NOT THIS FIGURE AND MUST NOT BE SWEPT WITH IT, so that the next pass does not repair a plant: `chapter-0295.md:41` (*corrected in a room five days ago*), `chapter-0304.md:55` and `chapter-0309.md:45` (the window, *those five days* and *the window has been open for five days*), and the `NN-five days` substring that rides inside the aggregate, the rises-and-falls window and the boards in fifteen more lines.**
**THREE. THE MAXIMUM RUN OF THE REFRAIN FAMILY IS ONE AND NOT THREE, AND THE THREE IS WITHDRAWN.** `state/continuity.md` and `reviews/batch-0005-v07-repair.findings.md` both record a measured maximum run of three in Batch 0001's ten chapters and name it as a guardrail-10 breach owed to this close. **SPLITTING ALL 1,680 PARAGRAPHS ON BLANK LINES AND COUNTING CONSECUTIVE PARAGRAPHS OPENING WITH THE *Nobody said anything and the fen entered …* CONNECTIVE GIVES A MAXIMUM RUN OF ONE IN EVERY CHAPTER OF THE VOLUME, AND THE THREE IS THE COUNT OF FAMILY OPENINGS IN A CHAPTER, WHICH IS NOT A RUN. THERE IS NO BREACH AND NO DEBT.** This is the one figure of the three that was in the state layer, and it is corrected here and in `state/current.md` with the old form named.

**AND THE TWO DEBTS THIS CLOSE FOUND, ONE OF WHICH IS PAID ABOVE. THE FOUR AND A HALF MILES IS THORNWILD AND NOT THE NORTH ROW, and the north row is half a mile, and the withdrawn form is named in three places and repaired in the state layer because a state layer is a close's to repair. AND `state/current.md` NO LONGER TELLS A CLOSE TO PAY A ONE-WORD REPAIR IN A CLOSED CHAPTER; IT NAMES THE WORD AND THE FIX AND SAYS THAT THE PAYMENT OWES A REPAIR PASS ON BATCH 0001 AND NOT A CLOSE.**

## THE COMPACTION DECISION, MADE ON THE PAGE, AND IT IS A DECLINE AGAIN

**DECLINED. THE REASON IS NOT *IT IS RISKY*.** `state/continuity.md` is 2,154,999 bytes in 7,384 lines, `state/open-threads.md` is 857,416 bytes in 3,078 lines, `state/chapter-summaries.md` is 1,096,087 bytes in 1,372 lines, measured after this section was appended and after the four state repairs this close made in it. THE TWO EARLIER SETS ARE NAMED RATHER THAN OVERWRITTEN: 2,125,568 and 7,287, 843,941 and 3,052, and 1,092,510 and 1,358, measured before this pass appended anything, and 2,154,780 and 7,384, 857,416 and 3,078, and 1,096,087 and 1,372, measured before this line. A CLOSE THAT APPENDS ITS OWN FIGURES TO THE FILES IT MEASURES CAN NEVER PUBLISH A FINAL SIZE; THE MEASUREMENT HAS A MOMENT ATTACHED TO IT AND THE MOMENT IS NAMED. All three are append-only and nothing in four years has compacted them.

**THE REASON, WHICH IS SPECIFIC AND FALSIFIABLE AND WHICH THE VOLUME SUPPLIES FOUR TIMES OVER.** These files are not dead sections with live ones on top. **They are a chain in which a later section exists for the purpose of naming an earlier section's figure as withdrawn, and the withdrawal is the only thing standing between this repository and a figure coming back.** Volume 07 is the proof: a month-frame that turns two days early because the current form of a rule was corrected and the earlier form left standing; a reading-out given two different days in two chapters of the same batch; a barrow put at twice a month because nobody could raise a figure and nobody could lower one; and the *five days* debt itself, which exists as a debt only because the record that withdrew it was appended rather than substituted. **A compaction that keeps the current form of every claim and drops the withdrawals does not save four megabytes. It converts a volume's correction history into a set of numbers that agree with themselves and are wrong, which is the exact failure `reviews/README.md` exists to prevent.** The git archive is a backstop for *content*. It is not a backstop for *which content is live*, and which is live is the one question a close cannot answer for a volume that has not been written.

**WHAT A COMPACTION MUST NOT LOSE, RESTATED AND ADDED TO.** The object rows. The day-minus rules. The rota arithmetic. The two counts that share one sentence. The withdrawn figures, each with the form it is withdrawn in beside the form that replaced it. The figure of every chapter in every batch table. **AND FOUR THINGS NOBODY ELSE KNOWS: that the maximum run of the refrain family is one and the three is a misreading of a count; that the British `favour` stands three times in `chapter-0325.md:39` against guardrail 3; that the four and a half miles is Thornwild, that it stands twenty-six times on twenty-five lines in eleven chapters and the thirteen in circulation was short by half; and that *five days* stands in eleven prose sites in five chapters across three batches and not in seven in three, that the whole of the miss is Batch 0003 and `chapter-0321.md`, and that four other uses of the same two words are not this figure.**

## THE ONE THING THE VOLUME 07 CLOSE DID NOT DO, WHICH IS THE THING ITS OWN AUTHORSHIP FORBIDS

**IT DID NOT REPAIR ELEVEN DEFECTS.** They are in `reviews/volume-07.findings.md` with their chapters and their lines: a British spelling three times in one line; a sheet that answers a request entered ten days after the answer; a barrow given a day it does not have; a month-frame broken in two places and in two batches; a barrow at twice a month against nine hundred journeys; one man given both times on one road; a clerk's block that gives a man a sentence he does not say; a chapter with no entry that the pattern does not explain; and three pages where the two-foot gap is named with no end and a fourth where a sentence does not parse. **A close may not change a day, a figure, a count or a name, and it changed none, and the finding against a chapter is written down rather than made good, which is the only honest thing a close can do with a defect in a book that is finished.**

**AND THE ONE-LINE VERSION. The volume is 140,227 words across forty-nine chapters and the manuscript is 1,024,475 across 343 with no residual, and every figure in the fifty-one mornings derives from the page; eleven defects are reported and none repaired; one of the three debts the last pass left is a figure that was never a debt; one state figure is repaired and named; the thirty-five threads are thirty-five; and the three append-only files are still not compacted, for a reason that is about withdrawals and not about risk.**

# VOLUME 07 CLOSE -- THE REVIEW REPAIR PASS, THREE FIGURES RE-MEASURED, AND WHAT IT DID NOT TOUCH

**THIS SECTION GOVERNS THE THREE FIGURES BELOW AND IT GOVERNS THEM OVER *VOLUME 07 - THE CLOSE*, WHICH GOVERNS THE REST OF THE VOLUME. WHERE THE TWO DIFFER ON *about four people*, ON THE NUMBER OF OCCURRENCES OF *FOUR AND A HALF*, AND ON THE NUMBER OF SITES OF *FIVE DAYS*, THIS SECTION IS THE ONE A LATER PHASE IS TO CARRY. THE FINDINGS FILE OF THIS PASS IS `reviews/volume-07-close-repair.findings.md`.**

**WHAT THIS PASS WAS. The reviewer phase's log, `logs/close.review.log`, WAS CUT OFF BEFORE IT WROTE A REPORT.** It had run the four mechanical checks, confirmed the totals, re-derived the *`about four people`* count, begun a spelling sweep and begun a check of the *four and a half* citation list, and it was interrupted mid-command. `logs/` IS GITIGNORED AND NO LOG FILE IS IN ANY COMMIT, SO THE ONLY SURVIVING EVIDENCE OF WHAT IT HAD FOUND IS A TRANSCRIPT. **THIS PASS RE-RAN AND COMPLETED THE THREE MEASUREMENTS THAT TRANSCRIPT HAD ACTUALLY MADE, AND EVERY FIGURE IN THEM WAS RE-DERIVED FROM THE CHAPTER FILES BY SCRIPT RATHER THAN TAKEN FROM THE TRANSCRIPT'S OPINION.**

**NOTHING IN THE FORTY-NINE CHAPTERS WAS TOUCHED, AND NONE OF THE ELEVEN UNPAID DEFECTS WAS PAID.** A review fix pass may touch closed files where a close may not, and this one did not, **because none of the three findings is a defect in a chapter. All three are figures in the record about the chapters, and a figure in the record is repaired in the record.**

**ONE. `about four people` IS THIRTY-EIGHT AND FORTY-EIGHT AND THE EARLIER PASS WITHDREW A FIGURE THAT WAS RIGHT.** It stood as *IS FORTY-EIGHT AND NOT 38*, calling 48 *the exact string*. **MEASURED OVER THE NINE CHAPTERS, THE EXACT CASE-SENSITIVE STRING IS 38 AND THE CASE-INSENSITIVE COUNT IS 48, THE WIDER HEDGE *about four* IS 115 AND 128 RESPECTIVELY, AND THE TEN ARE THE SENTENCE-INITIAL CAPITALS BEING *About four people* AT `chapter-0335.md`, `:0336.md`, `:0338.md`, `:0339.md`, `chapter-0341.md` TWICE, `:0342.md` TWICE AND `:0343.md` TWICE. 38 IS RESTORED AND IS NOT WITHDRAWN; 48 WAS NEVER THE EXACT STRING; AND THE PROSE WAS CORRECTLY LEFT ALONE BEFORE AND IS CORRECTLY LEFT ALONE NOW.** `nobody` IS 159 IN THE NINE CHAPTERS AND NOT 111, AND THAT WITHDRAWAL STANDS AND IS RIGHT.

**TWO. *FOUR AND A HALF* STANDS TWENTY-SIX TIMES ON TWENTY-FIVE LINES IN ELEVEN CHAPTERS ACROSS ALL FIVE BATCHES, AND NOT THIRTEEN TIMES ON TEN.** EVERY ONE OF THE TWENTY-SIX IS SOREN RILL WALKING TO THORNWILD, **WHICH IS THE PART A VOLUME 08 WRITER NEEDS AND WHICH WAS RIGHT FROM THE FIRST MEASUREMENT; WHAT WAS WRONG WAS THE COUNT, WHICH WAS SHORT BY HALF, AND THE LIST, WHICH MISSED FIFTEEN LINES AND TWO CHAPTERS ENTIRELY, `chapter-0324.md` AND `chapter-0325.md`.** EVERY OMITTED LINE WAS OPENED AND READ AND SAYS THE SAME THING, being *four miles and a half on foot and at his own cost* at `chapter-0322.md:17`, *the man who had walked four miles and a half on Sunday* at `chapter-0324.md:31`, *the man who had come four miles and a half* at `chapter-0325.md:35`, *the man from four miles and a half* at `chapter-0325.md:57`, and *a man has come four miles and a half in the rain* at `chapter-0342.md:37` and `:69`. **THE NORTH ROW IS STILL HALF A MILE, at `chapter-0336.md:15` AND `:111`, AND THE WITHDRAWN FORM *THE FOUR AND A HALF MILES IS THE WALK TO THE NORTH ROW* IS STILL WITHDRAWN AND STILL MAY NOT COME BACK.**

**THREE. *FIVE DAYS*, IN THE SENSE THE DEBT IS ABOUT, STANDS IN ELEVEN PROSE SITES IN FIVE CHAPTERS ACROSS THREE BATCHES, AND WITH THE TWO PLACES IN THE OUTLINE THAT IS THIRTEEN.** THE SITES ARE `chapter-0312.md:29` AND `:47` (BATCH 0002), `chapter-0321.md:25`, `:33` AND `:45` (BATCH 0003), `chapter-0329.md:53`, `chapter-0330.md:35` AND `chapter-0331.md:19`, `:31`, `:53` AND `:57` (BATCH 0004). **THE WITHDRAWN FIGURES ARE *SEVEN PROSE SITES IN THREE CHAPTERS*, WHICH ITS OWN LIST OF EIGHT IN FOUR CONTRADICTED, AND *NINE PLACES*, WHICH ITS OWN LIST OF TEN CONTRADICTED, AND THE TWO WRONG FORMS DID NOT AGREE WITH EACH OTHER. THE MISS WAS ENTIRELY BATCH 0003: `chapter-0321.md` CARRIES THREE OF THE ELEVEN AND WAS IN NO LIST, AND A REPAIR PASS WORKING FROM THE EARLIER FIGURE WOULD HAVE OPENED BATCH 0002 AND BATCH 0004 AND LEFT A CLOSED BATCH HOLDING A THIRD OF THE DEBT UNTOUCHED. THE REPAIR PASS OWED BY THE VOLUME 08 PROMPT NAMES THREE BATCHES AND THE OUTLINE, NOT TWO BATCHES AND THE OUTLINE.** **AND THE EIGHTEEN USES OF THE SAME TWO WORDS THAT ARE NOT THIS FIGURE ARE NOW NAMED SO THAT THE PASS DOES NOT TAKE A PLANT WITH IT: fifteen are the `NN-five days` substring inside the aggregate, the rises-and-falls window and the boards, `chapter-0304.md:55` AND `chapter-0309.md:45` ARE THE WINDOW, `chapter-0295.md:41` IS *CORRECTED IN A ROOM FIVE DAYS AGO*, AND `chapter-0330.md:45` IS *ELEVEN YEARS AND THIRTY-FIVE DAYS*.**

**AND ONE CITATION IN THE CLOSE'S OWN FINDING 1 IS ALSO CORRECTED HERE, IN THE DIRECTION THAT MAKES A DEFECT LOOK SMALLER. THE AMERICAN `favor` STANDS FIVE TIMES ON FOUR LINES -- `chapter-0297.md:39`, `chapter-0307.md:41`, `chapter-0309.md:29` TWICE, `chapter-0309.md:47` -- AND `chapter-0325.md:39`, WHICH THE CLOSE LISTED AMONG THE AMERICAN SITES AND SAID DID BOTH SPELLINGS IN ONE CHAPTER, IS NOT AN AMERICAN SITE AT ALL. IT IS THE LINE THE BRITISH `favour` STANDS ON THREE TIMES AND IT CONTAINS NO AMERICAN FORM. NO CHAPTER IN THE VOLUME USES BOTH FORMS. THE GUARDRAIL 3 BREACH IS REAL AND IS THREE WORDS IN A CLOSED CHAPTER AND IS STILL UNPAID.**

**FOURTEEN SITES WERE REPAIRED ACROSS SIX FILES AND NO CHAPTER, AND EVERY WITHDRAWN FORM IS NAMED BESIDE ITS REPLACEMENT RATHER THAN OVERWRITTEN**, which is the convention the whole state layer is built on, and **a pass that silently replaced a wrong number would leave no trace that it was ever wrong, which in this repository has already cost a volume twice.**

**THE RULE THIS PASS PRODUCED, AND IT IS THE THIRD TIME THIS REPOSITORY HAS NEEDED IT AND THE THIRD TIME IN ONE PASS: A FIGURE IS NEVER WITHDRAWN WITHOUT THE TEST THAT PRODUCED IT; WHERE A PASS CITES A FIGURE AS A REASON, THE CITING PASS OWNS THE TEST; AND A FIGURE THAT APPEARS IN FIVE FILES IN TWO DIFFERENT WRONG FORMS IS NOT A FIGURE WITH A TYPO IN IT, IT IS A FIGURE NOBODY MEASURED. A LIST IS NOT A COUNT AND A COUNT IS NOT A VERIFICATION.**

**THE ONE-LINE VERSION. Three figures in the record about Volume 07 were re-measured and all three were wrong: a correct count was withdrawn because the test was not named, a count was short by half and its list missed two chapters, and a debt was under-counted by four with the whole of the miss in one unopened batch; no chapter was touched, none of the eleven unpaid defects was paid, the manuscript is still 1,024,475 words across 343 chapters, and the rule is that a figure is never withdrawn without the test that produced it.**

# VOLUME 08 -- THE PLANNING PHASE, WHAT IT MEASURED, AND THE TWO FAULTS IT FOUND IN ITS OWN PROMPT

**THIS SECTION GOVERNS THE VOLUME 08 OPENING STATE AND IT GOVERNS IT OVER *VOLUME 07 -- THE CLOSE*, WHICH GOVERNS THE REST OF VOLUME 07. THE FINDINGS FILE OF THIS PASS IS `reviews/volume-08-planning.findings.md`. ## THE REVIEW OF BATCH 0003, AND THE REPAIR PASS THAT FOLLOWED IT, AND THE ONE FINDING IN IT THAT WAS NOT ABOUT THE PROSE

**THE REVIEW FOUND THAT BATCH 0003, CHAPTERS 364 TO 373, WAS NOT PROSE BUT A TEMPLATE WITH COUNTERS SUBSTITUTED, AND THAT THE GATE SHIPPED IN THE BATCH 0004 PROMPT COULD NOT SEE IT, AND THAT BOTH THINGS ARE TRUE AT ONCE AND THE SECOND IS THE REASON THE FIRST GOT WRITTEN.**

**WHAT THE REPAIR DID, MEASURED.** Sixty-nine paragraphs of the hundred and sixty-nine in the ten chapters were the same paragraph as a paragraph elsewhere with the figures changed. Every one of them was rewritten. **AFTER THE REPAIR: ZERO near-duplicate paragraphs of thirty words or more within batch 0003, AT EIGHTY-FIVE PERCENT, COMPARED PAIRWISE AND NOT BY CLUSTERING. ZERO near-duplicate paragraphs between batch 0003 and batches 0001 and 0002, ON THE SAME MEASUREMENT. THE MEAN PAIRWISE EIGHT-GRAM OVERLAP OF THE BODY PROSE, WITH THE `Entered` BLOCKS EXCLUDED BECAUSE A BLOCK IS A DOCUMENT, FELL TO 7.8 PERCENT AGAINST 6.3 PERCENT FOR VOLUME 07, WHICH IS THE LAST VOLUME THAT WAS NOT AFFECTED.** It was 11.3 per cent including the blocks and about 16 per cent within the batch before.

**AND NOT ONE FIGURE MOVED.** Every canon figure of the ten chapters was extracted as a value and compared before and after: the third launder and its hundred-and-twenty-seventh through hundred-and-thirty-sixth places, the three returns and the four pairs of halves, the two day-minus boards and the count of mornings each was read out loud on, the aggregate of the four bodies of households on each of the ten days, the three rota figures, the reason-first counts of thirty-six and ninety-nine through a hundred and two and a hundred and sixty-three through a hundred and sixty-seven, the sixteen and seventeen blanks, the nineteen lines, the thirty-six and forty-two and forty-three and forty-four fields, the hundred and eighty-four on the form, the fourteen marks on the wall, and the seven day-and-no-figure entries. **ALL OF THEM ARE WHERE THEY WERE. A REWRITE THAT ALTERS A COUNT HAS GONE WRONG SOMEWHERE ELSE AND NOT IN THE PARAGRAPH, AND THIS ONE DID NOT.**

**WHAT WAS PRESERVED, BECAUSE IT WAS GOOD.** The scenes were not touched. The wood at the node, the walls close on both sides and the lamp on a chain and the hands on the wheel that were older than his own; the man who asked what day it was; the sack the woman who keeps the seed house put her hand on at the stitching and had carried out; the six different answers to who speaks for the eleven acres and the seventh; the four lines about a field that waited, said in about nine people, with the comfort enormous and nobody in the room calling it a comfort; the hand on the flat of the table left there until he had finished. **THE DEFECT WAS IN THE RECITALS AND NOT IN THE CHAPTERS, AND A REPAIR THAT HAD GONE THROUGH THE CHAPTERS WOULD HAVE DESTROYED THE ONLY THINGS IN THE VOLUME WORTH KEEPING.**

**THE GATE, WHICH WAS THE WORSE OF THE TWO FINDINGS.** The batch 0004 prompt required that no paragraph in volume 08 be *byte*-identical to any other, and supplied a script that tested byte identity. A writer who changes one numeral does not trip a byte test. That script printed `duplicated strings: 0` on the worst batch in the manuscript. **IT HAS BEEN REPLACED WITH A TEST THAT COMPARES EVERY PAIR OF PARAGRAPHS OF THIRTY WORDS OR MORE AND FAILS AT EIGHTY-FIVE PERCENT, WHICH IS WHERE A PARAGRAPH BECOMES A PARAPHRASE, AND IT HAS BEEN RUN AS SHIPPED TO CONFIRM IT RUNS.**

**AND THE FINDING THAT IS NOT ABOUT BATCH 0003, WHICH NOBODY SHOULD CLOSE BY FIXING TEN CHAPTERS.** Batches 0001 and 0002 carry between them some four hundred and eighty near-duplicate paragraph pairs, and the largest of them is one forty-four-word sentence in twenty of those twenty chapters. **THAT IS INHERITED DEBT IN TWO CLOSED PHASES AND IT IS NOT THIS PASS'S WORK AND HAS NOT BEEN TOUCHED.** It is recorded here so that it is a debt with a number on it and not a silence. **The measure for the whole volume now stands at 484 pairs.
